metadata.title: The endpoint case of the Bennett-Carbery-Tao multilinear Kakeya conjecture

nodes.name: Cylinder of radius $R$ around a line
nodes.statement: A cylinder of radius $R$ around a line $L \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is the set of all points $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$ within distance $R$ of $L$. The line $L$ is the core of the cylinder.

nodes.name: Directed volume $V_S(v)$
nodes.statement: For a hypersurface $S \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ and $v \in \mathbb{R}^n$, $V_S(v) := \int_S |v \cdot N| \, dvol_S$, where $N$ is the unit normal to $S$.

nodes.name: Visibility $Vis[S]$
nodes.statement: $Vis[S] := Vol(\{ v : |v| \le 1 \text{ and } V_S(v) \le 1 \})^{-1}$.

nodes.name: Mollified directed volume $\bar V_{Z \cap U}(v)$
nodes.statement: $\bar V_{Z \cap U}(v) := |B(Z,\epsilon)|^{-1} \int_{B(Z,\epsilon)} V_{Z' \cap U}(v) \, dZ'$, averaging $V$ over an $\epsilon$-ball in $\mathbb{RP}^N$.

nodes.name: Mollified visibility $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap U]$
nodes.statement: $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap U] := Vol(\{v : |v| \le 1 \text{ and } \bar V_{Z \cap U}(v) \le 1\})^{-1}$.

nodes.name: Bisection set $Bi(U_1,\dots,U_r)$
nodes.statement: $Bi(U_1,\dots,U_r) \subset \mathbb{RP}^N$ is the set of degree-$d$ algebraic hypersurfaces $Z$ that simultaneously bisect each open set $U_i$.

nodes.name: Distance metric on the space $Ell$ of ellipsoids
nodes.statement: On the space $Ell$ of closed ellipsoids in $\mathbb{R}^n$ centered at the origin, $dist_{Ell}(E_1,E_2) \le \log D$ iff $(1/D) E_1 \subset E_2 \subset D E_1$.

nodes.name: Multilinear Kakeya estimate (endpoint, Theorem 2)
nodes.statement: $\int \big[\prod_{j=1}^n \big(\sum_{a=1}^{A(j)} \chi_{T_{j,a}}\big)\big]^{1/(n-1)} \le C(n) \theta^{-1/(n-1)} \prod_{j=1}^n A(j)^{1/(n-1)}$.
assumptions: For each $1 \le j \le n$, $T_{j,a}$ ($1 \le a \le A(j)$) are unit cylinders in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with unit core vectors $v_{j,a}$
Quantitative transversality: $|\det(v_{1,a_1},\dots,v_{n,a_n})| \ge \theta > 0$ for any choice of $a_1,\dots,a_n$

nodes.name: Axis-aligned multilinear Kakeya volume estimate (Theorem 1)
nodes.statement: If $T_{j,a}$ ($1 \le j \le n$, $1 \le a \le A$) are unit cylinders with cores within angle $(100n)^{-1}$ of the $x_j$-axis, and $I = \cap_{j=1}^n \cup_{a=1}^A T_{j,a}$, then $Vol(I) \le C(n) A^{n/(n-1)}$.
assumptions: Each $T_{j,a}$ has core within angle $(100n)^{-1}$ of the $x_j$-axis

nodes.name: Loomis-Whitney inequality (special case)
nodes.statement: If $U \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is open and each axis-perpendicular projection $\pi_j(U)$ has $(n-1)$-dimensional volume at most $B$, then $Vol(U) \le B^{n/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Ham Sandwich Theorem
nodes.statement: Let $U_1,\dots,U_n$ be finite-volume open sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then there exists a hyperplane $H$ that bisects each $U_i$.
conclusions: There exists a hyperplane $H \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ bisecting every $U_i$

nodes.name: Polynomial Ham Sandwich Theorem
nodes.statement: Let $N = \binom{n+d}{d} - 1$ and let $U_1,\dots,U_N$ be finite-volume open sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then there is a degree-$d$ algebraic hypersurface $Z$ which bisects each $U_i$.
conclusions: There exists a degree-$d$ algebraic hypersurface $Z \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ which bisects every $U_i$

nodes.name: Borsuk-Ulam Theorem
nodes.statement: If $F: S^N \to \mathbb{R}^N$ is continuous with $F(-x) = -F(x)$ for all $x \in S^N$, then $0 \in F(S^N)$.

nodes.name: Cohomology ring of $\mathbb{RP}^N$
nodes.statement: $H^i(\mathbb{RP}^N, \mathbb{Z}_2) \cong \mathbb{Z}_2$ for $0 \le i \le N$, and $0$ otherwise. If $a$ is the non-zero element of $H^1$, then $a^i$ is the non-zero element of $H^i$ for $1 \le i \le N$.
conclusions: For $1 \le i \le N$, $a^i$ is non-zero in $H^i(\mathbb{RP}^N, \mathbb{Z}_2)$

nodes.name: Vanishing Lemma (Lusternik-Schnirelmann)
nodes.statement: Let $X$ be a CW complex and $a_1, a_2 \in H^*(X,R)$. If $a_1$ vanishes on open $S_1$ and $a_2$ on open $S_2$, then $a_1 \cup a_2$ vanishes on $S_1 \cup S_2$.

nodes.name: Cylinder estimate (Lemma 2.1)
nodes.statement: If $T$ is a cylinder of radius $r$ with core $v$ a unit vector and $Z$ is a degree-$d$ algebraic hypersurface, then $V_{Z \cap T}(v) \le \omega_{n-1} r^{n-1} d$.
assumptions: $v$ unit vector parallel to core of $T$

nodes.name: Volume vs. directed-volume sum (Lemma 2.2)
nodes.statement: If unit vectors $v_j$ satisfy $|e_j - v_j| < (100n)^{-1}$, then for any hypersurface $S$, $Vol(S) \le 2 \sum_{j=1}^n V_S(v_j)$.

nodes.name: Continuity Lemma
nodes.statement: If $U \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ is an open set of finite measure, then $m(\{x \in U : P(x) > 0\})$ depends continuously on $P \in V(d) \setminus \{0\}$.
conclusions: $P \mapsto m(\{x \in U : P(x) > 0\})$ is continuous on $V(d) \setminus \{0\}$

nodes.name: Basic Area Estimate
nodes.statement: If a hypersurface $S$ bisects a unit ball or unit cube, then $S$ has $(n-1)$-dimensional volume at least $c(n)$.
assumptions: $S$ hypersurface bisecting a unit ball or unit cube in $\mathbb{R}^n$

nodes.name: Bisection Lemma
nodes.statement: Let $a$ be the non-trivial class in $H^1(\mathbb{RP}^N, \mathbb{Z}_2)$ and $U \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ a finite-volume subset. Then $a$ vanishes on $\mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U)$.

nodes.name: Multiple Bisection Lemma
nodes.statement: For finite-volume open sets $U_1,\dots,U_r \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, the cohomology class $a^r$ vanishes on $\mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U_1,\dots,U_r)$.

nodes.name: Mollified volume / visibility properties (Lemma 5.1)
nodes.statement: For bounded open $U \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $\bar V_{Z\cap U}$ and $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap U]$ satisfy: scaling, convexity in $v$, additivity for disjoint unions, the cylinder bound $\bar V_{Z \cap T}(v) \le \omega_{n-1} r^{n-1} d$, the bisection lower bound $\bar V_{Z \cap B}(v) \gtrsim 1$ for some unit $v$ when $Z$ bisects $B$, and joint continuity in $Z \in \mathbb{RP}^N$.
assumptions: $Z$ degree-$d$ algebraic hypersurface; $\epsilon$ chosen sufficiently small
conclusions: (iii) Disjoint additivity: $\bar V_{Z \cap U_1 \sqcup U_2}(v) = \bar V_{Z \cap U_1}(v) + \bar V_{Z \cap U_2}(v)$
(iv) Cylinder estimate: $\bar V_{Z \cap T}(v) \le \omega_{n-1} r^{n-1} d$
(v) Bisection: if $Z$ bisects unit ball $B$, $\bar V_{Z \cap B}(v) \gtrsim 1$ for some unit $v$
(vi) Continuity: $\bar V_{Z \cap U}(v)$ and $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap U]$ are continuous in $Z \in \mathbb{RP}^N$

nodes.name: Visibility Lemma
nodes.statement: There exists $C_n > 1$ such that, with $L_M = \{Z \in \mathbb{RP}^N : \overline{Vis}[Z \cap B(p,1)] \le M\}$ and $a$ the non-zero class in $H^1(\mathbb{RP}^N, \mathbb{Z}_2)$, the class $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes on a neighborhood of $L_M$.
conclusions: $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes on a neighborhood of $L_M = \{Z : \overline{Vis}[Z \cap B(p,1)] \le M\}$

nodes.name: Weak Visibility Lemma
nodes.statement: If $E$ is an ellipsoid contained in the unit ball with $Vol(E) \ge M^{-1}$, then the cohomology class $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes on a neighborhood of $L(E) = \{Z : \bar V_{Z \cap B(p,1)}(v) \le 1 \;\forall v \in E\}$.
conclusions: $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes on a neighborhood of $L(E)$

nodes.name: Directed-volume bound for surfaces bisecting an ellipsoid
nodes.statement: If $Z$ bisects $E'$ with principal axes $E'_j e_j$, then for some $1 \le j \le n$, $\bar V_{Z \cap E'}(e_j) \gtrsim Vol(E')/E'_j$.
assumptions: $E'$ ellipsoid with principal axes of lengths $E'_1,\dots,E'_n$ along orthonormal $e_1,\dots,e_n$

nodes.name: Large visibility on many cubes
nodes.statement: Given $M : \{Q_k\} \to \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ on the unit lattice cubes, there is an algebraic hypersurface $Z$ of degree $d \le C(n) [\sum_k M(Q_k)]^{1/n}$ with $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap Q_k] \ge M(Q_k)$ for every cube $Q_k$.
assumptions: $M$ is a function from unit-lattice $n$-cubes $\{Q_k\}$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ to $\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$
conclusions: Exists algebraic hypersurface $Z$ of degree $d \le C(n) [\sum_k M(Q_k)]^{1/n}$

nodes.name: Visibility-vs-directional-volume product (Lemma 6.1)
nodes.statement: For each cube $Q_k$, $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap Q_k] < C(n) \theta^{-1} \prod_{j=1}^n \bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})$.
assumptions: $Z$ algebraic hypersurface (with hyperplanes added so $\bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v) \ge |v|$)
$v_{j,k}$ chosen so $\bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,k}) = \min_a \bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,a})$

nodes.name: Average directional volume along a tube (Lemma 7.1)
nodes.section: 7 Box estimates for unions of tubes
nodes.statement: For an algebraic hypersurface $Z'$ of degree $\lesssim L$ and a tube $T$ of radius 1, length $L$, with core direction $v$, $|T|^{-1} \int_T V_{Z' \cap B(x,1)}(v) \, dx \lesssim 1$.
assumptions: $T \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ unit-radius cylinder of length $L$ with core direction $v$

nodes.name: Box Estimate (planiness for unions of tubes)
nodes.section: 7 Box estimates for unions of tubes
nodes.statement: There is $C(n) > 0$ such that, for any union $X$ of unit cylinders of length $L \gg 1$, one can choose a symmetric convex body $B(x)$ centered at $x$ with $Vol(B(x)) \le Vol(X)$ and the property that for every cylinder $T \subset X$ and random $x \in T$, $T \subset \sigma B(x)$ with probability $\ge 1 - C(n)\sigma^{-1}$.
assumptions: $X \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ union of cylinders of radius 1 and length $L \gg 1$
conclusions: For each $x \in X$ there is a symmetric convex body $B(x)$ centered at $x$ with $Vol(B(x)) \le Vol(X)$
For every cylinder $T \subset X$ of radius 1 and length $L$, with $x \in T$ uniform, $\Pr(T \subset \sigma B(x)) \ge 1 - C(n)\sigma^{-1}$

nodes.name: Gromov covering proposition
nodes.statement: If $f : X \to \mathbb{R}^m$ is a map and $\alpha \in H^*(X)$ vanishes on $f^{-1}(B(y,1))$ for every unit ball, then $\alpha^{m+1}$ vanishes on all of $X$.
nodes.origin_citation: Gromov, Singularities, expanders, and topology of mappings (preprint 2007)

nodes.name: Covering Estimate (Lusternik-Schnirelmann)
nodes.statement: If $\mathbb{RP}^N$ is covered by contractible open sets $S_1,\dots,S_r$, then $r \ge N+1$.
assumptions: $\mathbb{RP}^N$ covered by open sets $S_1,\dots,S_r$, each contractible

nodes.name: Directed volume formula via projection
nodes.statement: $V_S(v) = \int_{v^\perp} |S \cap \pi_v^{-1}(y)| \, dy$ for unit vector $v$.

nodes.name: Reduction to $F(Q_k)$ sum (*)
nodes.statement: $\sum_k F(Q_k)^{1/(n-1)} < C(n) \theta^{-1/(n-1)} \prod_{j=1}^n A(j)^{1/(n-1)}$, where $F(Q_k) = \prod_{j=1}^n M_j(Q_k)$ and $M_j(Q_k)$ is the number of tubes $T_{j,a}$ through $Q_k$.

nodes.name: Visibility of a unit $(n-1)$-disk in $\{x_n=0\}$
nodes.statement: For $S$ a unit $(n-1)$-disk in $\{x_n=0\}$, $V_S(v) = \omega_{n-1} |v_n|$ and $Vis[S]$ is of order 1.

nodes.name: Visibility of a union of axis-perpendicular disks
nodes.statement: For $S$ the union of $N_j$ unit disks perpendicular to $x_j$, $V_S(v) \approx \sum_j N_j |v_j|$ and $Vis[S] \sim N_1 \cdots N_n$.

nodes.name: Proof of the polynomial ham sandwich theorem (Borsuk-Ulam)
nodes.statement: Define $F_i(P) = Vol\{P>0\} - Vol\{P<0\}$ on the unit sphere $S^N \subset V(d)$. Each $F_i$ is continuous and odd, so the vector $F = (F_1,\dots,F_N)$ has a zero by Borsuk-Ulam, giving a $P$ whose zero-set bisects every $U_i$.

nodes.name: Alternate proof of polynomial ham sandwich (vanishing-lemma route)
nodes.statement: Apply the multiple bisection lemma: $a^N$ vanishes on $\mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U_1,\dots,U_N)$. Since $a^N \ne 0$ in $H^*(\mathbb{RP}^N, \mathbb{Z}_2)$, $Bi(U_1,\dots,U_N) \ne \emptyset$.

nodes.name: Proof of Continuity Lemma
nodes.statement: Egorov gives uniform convergence of $P_n \to P$ off a small set; a $\delta$-thickening of $\{P=0\}$ has small measure, so the volumes of $\{P_n>0\}$ and $\{P>0\}$ differ by $O(\epsilon)$.

nodes.name: Proof of cylinder estimate (Lemma 2.1)
nodes.statement: $\pi_v(T)$ is an $(n-1)$-disk of radius $r$; for almost every $y$, $|Z \cap \pi_v^{-1}(y)| \le d$ since lines meet a degree-$d$ surface in $\le d$ points unless contained.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 2.2 (volume vs. directed volumes)
nodes.statement: Pointwise $\sum_j |v_j \cdot N(x)| \ge \sum_j |e_j \cdot N(x)| - 1/100 \ge 99/100$; integrate over $S$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (axis-aligned multilinear Kakeya)
nodes.statement: Bisect lattice cubes intersecting $I$ by a degree-$d$ hypersurface with $d \lesssim V^{1/n}$, find a popular tube via pigeonhole, and combine the cylinder estimate $V_{Z \cap \tilde T}(v) \lesssim V^{1/n}$ with the lower bound $V_{Z \cap \tilde T}(v) \gtrsim V/A$ to obtain $V \lesssim A^{n/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Bisection Lemma
nodes.statement: If $a$ failed to vanish off $Bi(U)$, a 1-cycle $c \subset \mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U)$ detects $a$; lifting to a 1-parameter family of polynomials $P_Z \to -P_Z$ and using the Continuity Lemma yields some $P$ in the family bisecting $U$, a contradiction.

nodes.name: Proof of Multiple Bisection Lemma
nodes.statement: By the bisection lemma, $a$ vanishes on each open $\mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U_i)$; the vanishing lemma then gives $a^r$ vanishes on their union, which equals $\mathbb{RP}^N - Bi(U_1,\dots,U_r)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Covering Estimate
nodes.statement: Each $S_i$ is contractible, so $a$ vanishes on it; iterate the vanishing lemma to get $a^r$ vanishes on $\mathbb{RP}^N$, hence $r \ge N+1$.

nodes.name: Proof of Gromov covering proposition
nodes.statement: Triangulate $\mathbb{R}^m$ at scale $1/4$, take a cover $\{U_i\}$ indexed by simplices so simplices of equal dimension give disjoint $U_i$; each $U_i$ sits in a unit ball so $\alpha$ vanishes on $f^{-1}(U_i)$. The union $V_l$ over $l$-dim simplices is disjoint, so $\alpha$ vanishes there. Apply Lusternik-Schnirelmann to the $m+1$ disjoint blocks.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 5.1 (mollified properties)
nodes.statement: (i)-(iii) follow by direct computation; (iv) by averaging Lemma 2.1; (v) by combining the Continuity Lemma with Lemma 2.2 and averaging; (vi) by boundedness/Lipschitz estimates and the Crofton bound $Vol(Z \cap U) \lesssim_d 1$.

nodes.name: Proof of Visibility Lemma
nodes.statement: Reduce to the Weak Visibility Lemma over a 1-separated family of ellipsoids $Ell_1,\dots,Ell_s$ in $Ell[M]$, partition $L_M$ into closed sets $A_k$ approximating each $Ell_k$ via Fritz John's lemma, bound the multiplicity of the cover by the GL-symmetry of $Ell$, and apply the vanishing lemma colour-by-colour to multiply the exponent by a dimensional constant.

nodes.name: Proof of Weak Visibility Lemma
nodes.statement: Let $E' = E/A(n)$ and $U_1,\dots,U_k$ be a maximal disjoint family of parallel translates of $E'$ in $B(p,1)$. If $a^k$ failed to vanish on $L(E)$, the multiple bisection lemma gives a $Z$ bisecting every $U_i$; the directed-volume bound on bisecting ellipsoids forces $\bar V_{Z \cap B(p,1)}(E_j e_j) > 1$, contradicting $Z \in L(E)$. Hence $a^k$ vanishes on $L(E)$ with $k \lesssim A(n)^n M$.

nodes.name: Proof of bisecting-ellipsoid directed-volume bound
nodes.statement: Pull $E'$ back to the unit ball by the diagonal linear map $L$ scaling $e_j$ by $1/E'_j$; $L(Z)$ bisects $B$, so by Lemma 5.1(v) some $\bar V_{L(Z)\cap B}(e_j) \gtrsim 1$. Push back through the projection identity $V_{Z' \cap E}(e_j) = (\prod_i E'_i)/E'_j \cdot V_{L(Z')\cap B}(e_j)$ and average.

nodes.name: Proof of Large Visibility on Many Cubes
nodes.statement: By the Visibility Lemma, $a^{C(n) M(Q_k)}$ vanishes near each $S[Q_k]$. The vanishing lemma then gives $a^{C(n) \sum_k M(Q_k)}$ vanishes near $\cup_k S[Q_k]$. Since $a^N \ne 0$, choosing $C(n) \sum_k M(Q_k) < c(n) d^n \le N$ yields a $Z$ outside every $S[Q_k]$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 2 (multilinear Kakeya endpoint)
nodes.statement: Find $Z$ with controlled visibility on every cube via Section 5; combine the cylinder estimate $\sum_{Q_k \cap T_{j,a} \neq \emptyset} \bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,a}) \lesssim S$ with Lemma 6.1 and Holder to bound $\sum_k F(Q_k)^{1/(n-1)}$ by $\theta^{-1/(n-1)} \prod_j A(j)^{1/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 6.1 (visibility-product bound)
nodes.statement: Set $v'_{j,k} = v_{j,k}/\bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})$; convexity of $\bar V$ shows $\bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v) \le 1$ on the convex hull of $\pm v'_{j,k}$. The convex hull has volume $\gtrsim \theta \prod_j \bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})^{-1}$ by transversality, so the visibility — its inverse — is $\le C(n)\theta^{-1}\prod_j \bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})$.

nodes.name: Proof of Box Estimate
nodes.section: 7 Box estimates for unions of tubes
nodes.statement: Cover $X$ by $\lesssim Vol(X)$ small balls $B_i$ and apply the Large-Visibility-on-Many-Cubes lemma to get $Z$ with $\overline{Vis}[Z\cap B_i] \ge L^n/Vol(X)$. Define $B(x)$ from the level set of $\bar V_{Z \cap B(x,1)}$, rescaled by $L$. Tubes escape $\sigma B(x)$ only when $\bar V_{Z \cap B(x,1)}(v) \ge \sigma/2$, and Lemma 7.1 controls the average value.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 7.1
nodes.statement: Expand $|T|^{-1} \int_T V_{Z'\cap B(x,1)}(v) dx$ via Fubini onto $Z' \cap 3T$; the cylinder estimate (Lemma 2.1) bounds $V_{Z'\cap 3T}(v) \lesssim L$.

nodes.name: Proof of Vanishing Lemma (de Rham case)
nodes.statement: Represent $a_1$ by a differential form $\alpha_1$. Since $a_1|_{S_1}=0$, write $\alpha_1 = d\beta$ on $S_1$; extend $\beta$ to all of $M$ to obtain a representative vanishing on a compact $K_1 \subset S_1$. Do the same for $\alpha_2$ on $K_2 \subset S_2$. The wedge product $\alpha_1 \wedge \alpha_2$ then vanishes on $K_1 \cup K_2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Vanishing Lemma (general singular case)
nodes.statement: Choose singular cocycles $\alpha_i$ representing $a_i$ that vanish on $S_i$ via boundary corrections. For any singular simplex $f : \Delta \to S_1 \cup S_2$, subdivide $\Delta$ finely so each piece is supported in $S_1$ or $S_2$. Then $\alpha_1 \cup \alpha_2$ evaluates to zero on each piece, and cocycle invariance under boundaries gives $(\alpha_1 \cup \alpha_2)(f) = 0$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2 generalizes Theorem 1
nodes.statement: If each $v_{j,a}$ is within angle $(100n)^{-1}$ of $e_j$, the determinant transversality holds. Since the integrand is $\ge 1$ on $I$, Theorem 2 implies the volume bound $Vol(I) \le C(n) A^{n/(n-1)}$ of Theorem 1.

nodes.name: Loomis-Whitney as the sharp axis-parallel limit
nodes.statement: When all tubes are exactly axis-parallel, $\pi_j(I)$ has volume $\lesssim A$, so Loomis-Whitney recovers the bound $Vol(I) \lesssim A^{n/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Why mollify the visibility?
nodes.statement: $Vis[Z \cap Q]$ is not continuous in $Z$, which obstructs Lusternik-Schnirelmann arguments; averaging over a small $\epsilon$-ball in $\mathbb{RP}^N$ restores joint continuity while preserving the relevant inequalities.

nodes.name: Why include $|v|\le 1$ in $Vis[S]$?
nodes.statement: Without $|v|\le1$ a flat disk would have visibility 0; including it makes the empty set have visibility $\sim 1$, which is acceptable provided one restricts to $S$ inside a unit cube with $Vol(S) \ge 1$.

nodes.name: Reduce to lattice-cube count
nodes.statement: Let $Q_1,\dots,Q_V$ be the unit lattice cubes intersecting $I$. It suffices to prove $V \lesssim A^{n/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Bisect every cube by a polynomial $Z$ of degree $\lesssim V^{1/n}$
nodes.statement: By the polynomial ham sandwich theorem, find an algebraic hypersurface $Z$ of degree $d \lesssim V^{1/n}$ bisecting each $Q_k$; hence $Vol(Q_k \cap Z) \gtrsim 1$.

nodes.name: Pick a heavy direction in each cube via Lemma 2.2
nodes.statement: For each $Q_k$ pick $a_j(k)$ with $T_{j,a_j(k)} \cap Q_k \ne \emptyset$; by Lemma 2.2, $\sum_j V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,a_j(k)}) \gtrsim 1$, so some $V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j(k),a(k)}) \gtrsim 1$.

nodes.name: Pigeonhole to a popular tube
nodes.statement: Only $nA$ tubes total, so some tube $T_{j,a}$ has $\gtrsim V/A$ associated cubes $Q_k$ with $V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,a}) \gtrsim 1$.

nodes.name: Thicken to $\tilde T_{j,a}$ and bound directed volume below
nodes.statement: Let $\tilde T_{j,a}$ be the $\sqrt n$-neighborhood of $T_{j,a}$, a cylinder of radius $1+\sqrt n$. Then $V_{Z \cap \tilde T_{j,a}}(v_{j,a}) \gtrsim V/A$.

nodes.name: Apply cylinder estimate and conclude
nodes.statement: Lemma 2.1 gives $V_{Z \cap \tilde T_{j,a}}(v_{j,a}) \lesssim V^{1/n}$, so $V/A \lesssim V^{1/n}$, i.e. $V \lesssim A^{n/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Reduce to the discrete sum (*)
nodes.statement: On the unit lattice, set $M_j(Q_k) = \#\{a : T_{j,a} \cap Q_k \neq \emptyset\}$ and $F(Q_k) = \prod_j M_j(Q_k)$. It suffices to prove $\sum_k F(Q_k)^{1/(n-1)} \lesssim \theta^{-1/(n-1)} \prod_j A(j)^{1/(n-1)}$.

nodes.name: Choose hypersurface $Z_0$ with calibrated visibility
nodes.statement: By the Large-Visibility-on-Many-Cubes lemma, find $Z_0$ of degree $\lesssim S$ with $\overline{Vis}[Z_0 \cap Q_k] \ge S^n F(Q_k)^{1/(n-1)} [\sum_k F(Q_k)^{1/(n-1)}]^{-1}$.

nodes.name: Augment $Z_0$ with hyperplanes
nodes.statement: Add $C(n) S$ hyperplanes to $Z_0$ to get $Z$ of degree $\lesssim S$ that retains the visibility bound and additionally satisfies $\bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v) \ge |v|$ for every $Q_k$ with $F(Q_k) > 0$.

nodes.name: Cylinder estimate along each tube
nodes.statement: For every tube $T_{j,a}$, $\sum_{Q_k \cap T_{j,a} \ne \emptyset} \bar V_{Z \cap Q_k}(v_{j,a}) \lesssim S$.

nodes.name: Choose worst direction $v_{j,k}$ per cube and sum
nodes.statement: For each $Q_k$, pick $v_{j,k}$ minimizing $\bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,a})$ over $a$; summing the cylinder estimate over $a$ yields $\sum_{Q_k} M_j(Q_k) \bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,k}) \lesssim S A(j)$.

nodes.name: Bound visibility by directional-volume product (Lemma 6.1)
nodes.statement: $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap Q_k] < C(n) \theta^{-1} \prod_j \bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})$, using transversality and convexity of $\bar V$.

nodes.name: Holder chain to combine estimates
nodes.statement: Use $S [\sum_k F^{1/(n-1)}]^{(n-1)/n} = \sum_k S F^{1/(n-1)}/[\sum F^{1/(n-1)}]^{1/n} \le \sum_k F^{1/n} \overline{Vis}^{1/n} \lesssim \theta^{-1/n} \prod_j [\sum_k M_j(Q_k) \bar V_{Z\cap Q_k}(v_{j,k})]^{1/n}$.

nodes.name: Plug in cylinder estimate and clear $S$
nodes.statement: Substitute (2) to obtain $S [\sum_k F^{1/(n-1)}]^{(n-1)/n} \lesssim S \theta^{-1/n} \prod_j A(j)^{1/n}$; cancel $S$ and raise to the power $n/(n-1)$ to get $(*)$.

nodes.name: Sample 1-separated ellipsoids
nodes.statement: Choose a maximal 1-separated subset $Ell_1,\dots,Ell_s$ of $Ell[M]$ in the metric $dist_{Ell}$.

nodes.name: Partition $L_M$ into closed sets $A_k$
nodes.statement: For $Z \in L_M$, set $K[Z] = \{v : |v|\le 1, \bar V_{Z\cap B(p,1)}(v) \le 1\}$ and put $Z \in A_k$ iff $(10n)^{-1/2} Ell_k \subset K[Z] \subset (10n)^{1/2} Ell_k$. Fritz John's lemma shows $\{A_k\}$ covers $L_M$; $A_k \subset L((10n)^{-1/2} Ell_k)$.

nodes.name: Apply weak visibility lemma to each $A_k$
nodes.statement: By the weak visibility lemma, $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes on a neighborhood $B_k$ of each $A_k$.

nodes.name: Bound the cover multiplicity
nodes.statement: Two $A_k$'s overlap only when their ellipsoids lie within distance $C(n)$ in $Ell$. Compactness and the transitive $GL(n,\mathbb{R})$-action on $Ell$ give a uniform bound $C'(n)$ on the multiplicity of $\{B_k\}$.

nodes.name: Colour and apply vanishing lemma
nodes.statement: Colour the $B_k$ with $C'(n)$ colours so same-colour blocks are disjoint; on each colour-block $C_\alpha$, $a^{C_n M}$ vanishes. The vanishing lemma combines them to $a^{C''_n M}$ vanishing on a neighborhood of $L_M$.

nodes.name: Pack disjoint copies of $E'$ in $B(p,1)$
nodes.statement: Set $E' = E/A(n)$; let $U_1,\dots,U_k$ be a maximal disjoint family of parallel copies of $E'$ in $B(p,1)$, so $Vol(E') k \sim 1$ and $k \lesssim A(n)^n M$.

nodes.name: Contradiction setup: assume $a^k$ doesn't vanish on $L(E)$
nodes.statement: If $a^k$ failed to vanish on $L(E)$, the multiple bisection lemma yields $Z \in L(E)$ bisecting every $U_i$.

nodes.name: Bisecting-ellipsoid bound on directed volume
nodes.statement: For each $U_i$, Lemma 5.1(v) plus the linear-pullback computation give some $j$ with $\bar V_{Z \cap U_i}(e_j) \gtrsim Vol(E')/E'_j$.

nodes.name: Pigeonhole and contradiction
nodes.statement: Pigeonhole over $i$ gives a popular $j$ with $\bar V_{Z \cap B(p,1)}(e_j) \gtrsim A(n)/E_j$. Choosing $A(n)$ large yields $\bar V_{Z \cap B(p,1)}(E_j e_j) > 1$, contradicting $Z \in L(E)$. Hence $a^k$, and so $a^{C_n M}$, vanishes on a neighbourhood of $L(E)$.

nodes.name: Cover $X$ by small balls
nodes.statement: Pick disjoint balls $B_i$ of radius $1/10$ such that $\cup_i 3B_i$ covers $X$ and $\#\{B_i\} \lesssim Vol(X)$.

nodes.name: Build $Z$ with high visibility on the balls
nodes.statement: By the Large-Visibility-on-Many-Cubes lemma, choose an algebraic hypersurface $Z$ of degree $\lesssim L$ with $\overline{Vis}[Z \cap B_i] \ge L^n / Vol(X)$.

nodes.name: Define the box function $B(x)$
nodes.statement: Set $B_0(x) = \{v : |v| \le 1, \bar V_{Z \cap B(x,1)}(v) \le 1\}$ centred at $x$, and $B(x) = L \cdot B_0(x)$. Then $Vol(B(x)) \le Vol(X)$.

nodes.name: Bound the bad-set probability
nodes.statement: Bad points $x \in T$ where $T \not\subset \sigma B(x)$ satisfy $\bar V_{Z \cap B(x,1)}(v) \ge \sigma/2$. Lemma 7.1 gives $|T|^{-1} \int_T \bar V_{Z \cap B(x,1)}(v) dx \lesssim 1$, so the bad set has measure $\le 2C(n)\sigma^{-1} |T|$.
